newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Pakistan policeman in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Pakistan policeman in Karachi.

text.p: A Pakistani policeman who gained prominence in a crackdown on communal militants was killed by gunmen in the southern port city of Karachi on Monday, police said.
They said inspector Aslam Hayat, 35, was shot by three gunmen in Karachi's eastern district.
"Hayat was sitting with his friends on the roof of a house when three unidentified gunmen opened fire from the roof of a neighbouring house," a police official said.
Hayat was hit by eleven bullets, most of them in his back, and died instantly. No one else was hit.
Hayat was known for leading hazardous operations against militants of the ethnic Mohajir National Movement during the previous government of former prime minister Benazir Bhutto.
At least 175 people have died in ethnic, sectarian and political violence in Karachi this year compared to about 500 in the whole of 1996, and more than 2,000 in 1995.
